# Preface { .unnumbered }

These pages document the **iTRAILS workflow component**: a [GWF](https://gwf.app/)
pipeline that fits the TRAILS coalescent hidden Markov model
([Rivas-González et al., 2024](https://doi.org/10.1371/journal.pgen.1010836)) to a
four-genome alignment and decodes gene-tree topologies along the genome.

The pipeline runs on its own, and it is written so that a larger project can consume
it as a Git submodule. The pages are generated from the
[munch-group/itrails](https://github.com/munch-group/itrails) repository and published
with GitHub Pages; see [The documentation website](docs/website.qmd) for how that
works.

## What the pipeline does

Given three ingroup species **A**, **B**, **C** with topology ((A,B),C) and an
outgroup, iTRAILS estimates ancestral population sizes and speciation times from the
pattern of incomplete lineage sorting along the genome, and then labels each position
with a hidden state — a gene-tree topology combined with discretized coalescence
times.

The component wraps that in a GWF workflow that also prepares the input and splits
the work into genomic windows:

```{mermaid}
flowchart TD
    VCF["phased (g)VCFs<br/>+ optional reference FASTA"] --> ALIGN["<b>alignment/</b><br/>itrails_vcf2maf"]
    MAF["MAF alignment"] --> OPT
    ALIGN --> OPT["<b>optimize/</b><br/>itrails-optimize<br/>→ best_model.yaml"]
    ALIGN --> SPLIT
    MAF --> SPLIT["<b>split/</b><br/>windows of N bases"]
    SPLIT --> VIT["<b>viterbi/</b><br/>most likely state path"]
    SPLIT --> POST["<b>posterior/</b><br/>state probabilities"]
    OPT --> VIT
    OPT --> POST
    VIT --> CAT["<b>concat/</b><br/>genome-wide CSVs"]
    POST --> CAT
```

Each step writes to its own subfolder of the analysis directory, so outputs stay easy
to tell apart. Windowing and the VCF front end are both optional: the smallest
possible analysis is a MAF file plus a configuration file, which gives one model fit
and one decode of each kind.

## Repository layout

```txt
analyses.yml            what to analyze (standalone runs)
config/                 iTRAILS model configuration files
workflow.py             standalone GWF entry point
itrails_workflow.py     the workflow factory a parent project imports
scripts/                vcf_to_maf.py, split_maf.py, concat_windows.py, simulate_data.py
data/                   input alignments (a small simulated one is included)
notebooks/              result notebooks, executed by the workflow
steps/                  workflow output (not tracked by Git)
docs/                   these pages
```

::: { .callout-note }

Two reference documents in the repository root — `claude-itrails-ref.md` and
`claude-gwf-ref.md` — collect the iTRAILS command-line interface, file formats and
model parameters, and the GWF API. They are written as working references for
maintaining the pipeline and go deeper than these pages on both tools.

:::
